description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [MAG and MND +50% (25s)], [Switch Draw Mode II (Ice, Earth)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Comet Mode I (Rinoa)] and [Ice/EarthResonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Comet Mode I (Rinoa)
